 W.P(M
 Prayer :

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   India, praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorari, to call fo  records pertaining to impugned order passed by the 2nd respondent i  Na.Ka.No.3710/A2/2023/U.Pa.A.324/03 dated 29.11.2023 and quash the  same as illegal.

For Petitioner : Mr.P.Ponraj  For Respondents : Mr.K.Balasubramani,
 Spl. Government Pleader R1 to R3  Mr.A.Albert James,
 Government Advocate for R4.
 ORDER Heard both sides.
2.The petitioner challenges the impugned order dated 29.11.2023 on the grounds set out in the affidavit filed in support of the writ petition.
3.I need not go into the said contentions for the simple reason that the writ petition is not maintainable.
The learned Special Government Pleader points out that the registration certificate under Food Safety and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Standards Act, 2006 is in the name of Savariraj.
The said Savariraj is none other than the petitioner's brother.
If at all, it is only Savariraj who can approach this Court for relief.
Merely because the impugned order dated 29.11.2023 is addressed to the petitioner, that will not by itself confer any locus standi.
The person in whose name the registration certificate stands will have to come before this Court.
This writ petition is dismissed as not maintainable.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
